title: 第17章 蓝尾毒蝎第18章 张梓轩
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
这个叫做‘青儿’的少女，身着淡雅青衣，身姿修长而柔韧，香肌玉肤，淡扫娥眉，一对剪水双瞳，顾盼流转间灵动自然。
别看这姑娘年龄不大，但身段发育却极好，青色长裙之下的身姿玲珑有致，曲线婀娜，腰肢纤细有力，野性十足，应该饱满的地方和那尤物柳卿相比，都不怎么逊色。
这两个女孩站在一起，一个如梦中仙子，不食人间烟火，一个如凡尘公主，七分骄纵霸道，两分可爱，一分妖娆。
那肌肤里有着荧光的‘姜妃棂’自然更加出尘，但这娇蛮野性身姿婀娜的‘青儿’也有超凡的容貌。
李天命倒是完全没想到，在这荒山野岭之中遇到的两个女孩，连这个‘青儿’的容貌，似乎都不比沐晴晴差多少，甚至在气质方面还有超越。
李天命本来以为‘青儿’是丫鬟婢女，现在一看明显不是。
这个‘青儿’气质出众，举止之间气场惊人，其身上有一种非常恐怖的气息，这是来自绝顶天才的气息和威严，这样的年轻人，不出意料哪怕在焱都，恐怕都身居高位。
“青儿，你别吓唬他，他不是坏人。
刚才我被凶兽追上了，还是他救了我呢。”
当青儿警惕的盯着李天命的时候，姜妃棂连忙拉着他的手臂说。
“是吗？”
青儿总算解除了警惕，上下端详一下李天命，道：“人模狗样的，别对棂儿起什么心思，赶紧走吧。”
看来这家伙很不友好啊，对方身份一定很高，所以习惯这样蔑视他人了。
“长得挺好看，一点礼貌都没有。”
李天命刚对这青儿还有些好感，毕竟美女肯定吃香。
但，对方知道李天命无恶意之后还不怎么客气，李天命当然不会给他好脸色看。
“你说什么？信不信我抽你耳光。”
青儿瞪眼道。
她凶起来的时候，身上的恐怖兽元流转出来，这应该是超越兽脉境的气息，证明这位很可能是‘灵源境’强者。
这个年纪成就灵源境，在焱都肯定都是响当当的人物。

“青儿，你别欺负哥哥，棂儿告诉你一个惊喜。”
“哥哥？我呸。”
青儿再次瞪了一眼李天命，李天命哭笑不得，她肯定把自己当做是那种诱骗无知少女的坏人了。
“你要不要听？”
姜妃棂嘟嘴了。
“好好，你说。”
青儿无奈道，看得出来她们关系非常好。
“我刚刚附灵在哥哥的身上，你猜附灵程度达到什么级别了？”
姜妃棂眨眨眼睛道。
“附灵？不是让你别随随便便附在别人身上吗！”
青儿头疼道。
“凶兽追我，我也没办法，你快猜！”
“就这边缘地域的臭玩意臭男人，顶多两级吧，不能再多了。”
青儿鄙视的看了李天命一眼。
“错了，你肯定不相信，达到满级了，不信你看看。”
content_en:
This girl named 'Qing'er' is dressed in an elegant green dress. She has a slender and flexible figure, fragrant skin, lightly swept brows, and a pair of water-cut pupils, which are agile and natural as she looks around.
Despite her young age, this girl has a well-developed figure. Her figure under the long green skirt is exquisite and graceful, with graceful curves, slender and strong waist, full of wildness, and the areas that should be plump are not inferior to that beauty Liu Qing.
These two girls stand together, one is like a fairy in a dream, not consuming the fireworks of the world, and the other is like an earthly princess, one part arrogant and domineering, two parts cute, and one part enchanting.
The 'Jiang Feiling' with fluorescent skin is naturally more extraordinary, but the delicate and wild 'Qing'er' with a graceful figure also has an extraordinary appearance.
Li Tianming had no idea that the two girls he met in this barren mountain and wilderness, even the appearance of this 'Qing'er' seemed not much worse than Mu Qingqing, and even surpassed her in terms of temperament.
Li Tianming originally thought that 'Qing'er' was a maid, but now it's obvious that she is not.
This 'Qing'er' has an outstanding temperament and an astonishing aura in his manners. He has a very terrifying aura about him, which is the aura and majesty of a supreme genius. It is not surprising that such a young man is probably in a high position even in Yandu.
"Qing'er, don't scare him, he is not a bad person.
I was overtaken by a ferocious beast just now, but it was he who saved me. "
When Qing'er stared at Li Tianming warily, Jiang Feiling quickly took his arm and said.
"Really?"
Qing'er finally let go of his vigilance, looked Li Tianming up and down, and said: "He looks like a dog, don't worry about Ling'er, just leave quickly."
It seems that this guy is very unfriendly. The other person must have a high status, so he is used to looking down on others like this.
"She's very good-looking, but has no manners at all."
Li Tianming just had a good impression of Qing'er, after all, beauties must be popular.
However, the other party was not very polite after knowing that Li Tianming had no ill intentions. Of course, Li Tianming would not give him a good look.
"What did you say? Believe it or not, I will slap you."
Qing'er stared.
When she became fierce, the terrifying beast energy flowed out of her body. This should be an aura that transcended the beast vein realm, proving that this person was probably a strong person in the 'Spirit Source Realm'.
Those who have reached the Spiritual Origin Realm at this age must be well-known figures in Yandu.
"Qing'er, don't bully your brother. Ling'er has a surprise for you."
"Brother? Bah."
Qing'er glared at Li Tianming again. Li Tianming didn't know whether to laugh or cry. She must have regarded herself as the kind of bad guy who seduces ignorant girls.
"Do you want to listen?"
Jiang Feiling pouted.
"Okay, tell me."
Qing'er said helplessly, it was obvious that they had a very good relationship.
"I just possessed my brother's spirit. What level do you think the spirit has reached?"
Jiang Feiling blinked her eyes and said.
"Possessed spirit? Didn't I tell you not to possess others casually?"
Qing'er said with a headache.
"The ferocious beast is chasing me, and there's nothing I can do about it. Just guess!"
"Just this stinky man from the fringe area, at most two levels, no more."
Qing'er glanced at Li Tianming with disdain.
"That's wrong. You definitely won't believe it. I've reached the full level. If you don't believe me, just take a look."
